families.name: Project execution
families.owner_example: Show this project's blockers and complete task 42.
families.required_result: Resolve the exact project and task, approve the mutation, record a receipt, and show updated state.
families.approval_boundary: Task creation and completion require the current policy decision and owner approval when requested.
families.stop_condition: The requested project state is verified or a bounded recovery is returned.

families.name: Local diagnosis
families.owner_example: Read the failing logs and run the safe health check.
families.required_result: Stay inside the file fence, run only the approved command, capture output, and ground the conclusion.
families.approval_boundary: Commands outside the safe policy require owner approval and file access never escapes its declared fence.
families.stop_condition: The diagnostic check finishes with captured evidence or a bounded failure and recovery choice.

families.name: Coding maintenance
families.owner_example: Use Developer to fix this MC limitation, run tests, and prepare the change for review.
families.required_result: Confirm one Developer handoff, run one qualified durable workflow, record checks and artifacts, and never merge or deploy silently.
families.approval_boundary: Proposal has no side effect; owner confirmation creates one workflow; merge and deploy retain existing approvals.
families.stop_condition: One linked Developer run reaches a truthful terminal state with changes, checks, and artifacts.

families.name: Browser work
families.owner_example: Open the approved site, inspect the form, and download the report.
families.required_result: Use allowlisted navigation, bounded interaction, screenshot or download evidence, and approval before submission.
families.approval_boundary: Form submission is an external action and always requires the policy and owner approval boundary.
families.stop_condition: The approved artifact is captured or the run returns a truthful browser recovery state.

families.name: GitHub monitoring and action
families.owner_example: Watch this repository, notify me on a failed check, and create an issue after approval.
families.required_result: Read fresh GitHub state, send one deduplicated Telegram notice, and create at most one approved issue with a receipt.
families.approval_boundary: GitHub writes require owner approval; reads and monitoring require fresh connector proof.
families.stop_condition: The source event, notification, and optional issue each have one matching receipt or a truthful setup state.
